**In progress: milestones 1 to 11 and 13 merged; milestone 12 has PR 1, PR 2, its follow-up, replay slice 1 (#375) and PR 3 (a watched replay wears the runner's cosmetics) in review.** Shards buy looks only, never power (owner rule 2026-11-13). Merged on main: the catalog in src/gameplay/progression/cosmetics/*.json (slots, families, tiers, collections, items); state, merge and caps in src/domain/cosmetics.ts; daily-claim receipts; the Shop SHARDS tab (src/presentation/screens/shard-shelves.ts); draw hooks for blade, swing trail and hit sparks in runs (#332); the passport title and banner, collections and named loadouts with identity-based merge (#345, #359; src/domain/cosmetic-loadouts.ts); plain item names and one Rootbound palette (#368). Each wearer keeps its own loadout and a blade-hit burst names its blade (BurstSource), so a replay racer and the live player each show their own look (#375). A replay record's look carries the loadout the runner wore at run start (one entry per slot at most), and a watched replay dresses the runner's blade in it: blade, trail and hit sparks, in the viewer's calm setting; an id the catalog does not know draws the default (codex/shards-replay-looks: src/app/replay/record-world.ts dress, src/app/replay/live-replay-production.ts). Item evolution is not scheduled (lead's decision). Every build target must deploy close together: builds before #345 strip createdAt, home and deletedLoadouts from saved loadouts.

- Next: Once PR 3 merges, milestone 12 is done except one optional piece: the runner's title and banner on the replay list row.
